headline: Long run done, ran hot: 166 load, 77min Z3-Z4 vs ~30 planned
summary: 25.7km / 1058m in 2h46, avg 149bpm, RPE 8. Climbs from km 7 sat at 159-165bpm, so the Z2 bulk became tempo. Final two steep descents at 176-184 spm, cadence target met. Race read: effort-equivalent pace puts VWT at 2h00-2h08 (moderate confidence). HRV 56 / RHR 50 / TSB -13.4: eat well, bed by 22:30, Mon is rest (Belgrade).
flags: Second long run in a row where climbs drift above the Z2 cap. Sat 31 has a hard 155bpm cap on the first 70min.
Wk7 rebuilt: 585 (+10% bias vs 530 base), load front-loaded Tue-Thu, Sun 1 now a spin.
